name: intellimeet
description: IntellMeet — AI-powered meetings. Root scripts run the whole stack (MongoDB + API + client).

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix server run test:coverage && npm --prefix client run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
